description: Meta-plan: Design a fully playable MMORPG with 12 classes, 10...
input_prompt: Plan tasks for: Design a fully playable MMORPG with 12 classes, 100 levels, 50 dungeons, PvP arenas, crafting, and player housing

sub_tasks.prompt: Define game mechanics, rules, and systems for the MMORPG
Create concept art, character models, and environment designs for the game
Develop the game engine and core mechanics
Design and implement 12 playable classes with unique abilities and playstyles
Design and implement a 100-level progression system with increasing difficulty and rewards
Design and implement 50 dungeons with unique layouts, enemies, and rewards
Design and implement PvP arenas with different game modes and rewards
Design and implement crafting system with various recipes and materials
Design and implement player housing system with customization options
Implement game server and client architecture
Implement game networking and online features
Test game for bugs, balance, and overall quality

required_context: Knowledge of game design principles and mechanics
Familiarity with game engines and programming languages
Understanding of online game development and networking
